loco.meaning: play at the written pitch again, after an octave sign (8va)
loco.zh: 八度记号（8va）结束后，恢复按谱面音高演奏

ritmico.meaning: rhythmic, with a clear, steady pulse
ritmico.zh: 有节奏感，拍子清晰而稳定

expressivo.meaning: with expression (an older spelling of espressivo)
expressivo.zh: 富有表情地（espressivo 的旧拼法）

al fine.zh: 演奏至 Fine 处结束

al coda.meaning: and then jump to the Coda

larghetto.meaning: rather broad, a little faster than largo

andantino.zh: 小行板，通常比行板稍快

allegretto.zh: 小快板，稍快，比快板轻巧

simile.meaning: keep going in the same way

stacc.meaning: short and detached; keep a clear gap between notes
stacc.zh: 断奏，音与音之间留出清楚的间隔

sempre stacc.meaning: continue playing every note short and detached, even where the dots are no longer printed
sempre stacc.zh: 始终断奏，即使后面没有继续标出断奏点

rubato.meaning: flexible time: stretch and push the beat for expression
rubato.zh: 自由速度，为表达乐句而灵活伸缩节拍

d.c..meaning: da capo: go back to the beginning

d.s..meaning: dal segno: go back to the sign 𝄋
d.s..zh: 从记号 𝄋 处反复（dal segno）

fine.meaning: the end, after a D.C. or D.S.
fine.zh: 结束处，用于 D.C. 或 D.S. 反复后

ppp.meaning: pianississimo, as soft as possible. Keep the air moving fast so it does not go flat
ppp.zh: 极弱，尽可能轻，保持气流速度，避免音偏低

pp.meaning: pianissimo, very soft. Soft notes on flute go flat, so keep the air fast and the opening small
pp.zh: 很弱，长笛弱奏时音高容易偏低，保持快速气流和较小的风口

p.meaning: piano, soft. Soft notes on flute go flat, so keep the air fast
p.zh: 弱，长笛弱奏时音高容易偏低，保持气流速度

f.meaning: forte, loud. Loud notes on flute go sharp, so aim the air a little lower
f.zh: 强，长笛强奏时音高容易偏高，可将气流方向稍微向下调整

ff.meaning: fortissimo, very loud. Loud notes on flute go sharp, so aim the air a little lower
ff.zh: 很强，长笛强奏时音高容易偏高，可将气流方向稍微向下调整

sf.meaning: sforzando, a sudden strong accent on this one note

sfz.meaning: sforzando, a sudden strong accent on this one note

fp.meaning: forte-piano, a loud attack that drops straight to soft
fp.zh: 强后即弱，强起音后立即转弱

en dehors.meaning: brought out (French), so let this line stand out above the accompaniment
en dehors.zh: 突出地（法语），让这条旋律比伴奏更突出

expressif.meaning: expressively, shaping the phrase with feeling
expressif.zh: 富有表情地，用情感塑造乐句

très modéré.meaning: very measured (French), calm and unhurried, well below a plain moderato
très modéré.zh: 很从容地（法语），平静、不急促，比一般中板慢得多

au mouvᵗ.meaning: back to the main speed (French, short for au mouvement)
au mouvᵗ.zh: 恢复原速（法语，au mouvement 的缩写）

marqué.zh: 着重地，每个音都清楚地加重（法语）

mouvementé.meaning: with more movement, a little livelier (French)
mouvementé.zh: 更有流动感，稍活跃地（法语）

allargando.meaning: broadening: slow down and play fuller
allargando.zh: 渐宽，放慢并使声音更饱满

allarg..meaning: short for allargando: slow down and play fuller
allarg..zh: 渐宽，放慢并使声音更饱满（allargando 的缩写）

marziale.meaning: like a march, firm and rhythmic
marziale.zh: 进行曲风格，坚定而有节奏感

martellato.meaning: hammered: every note strongly and separately accented
martellato.zh: 锤击般地，每个音都强而分明

stentato.meaning: laboured: hold back and give each note weight
stentato.zh: 吃力地，放慢并给每个音以分量

a guisa di barcarola.meaning: in the style of a barcarole, a gently rocking Venetian boat song
a guisa di barcarola.zh: 船歌风格，如威尼斯船歌般轻轻摇曳

ritardan..meaning: short for ritardando: gradually slow down

ten..meaning: short for tenuto: hold each note for its full value
ten..zh: 保持音，奏足每个音的时值（tenuto 的缩写）

espressif.meaning: expressively; a spelling variant of expressif in this score
espressif.zh: 富有表情地，本谱中 expressif 的另一种拼法

souple.meaning: supple and flexible, without rigid phrasing
souple.zh: 柔韧而灵活地，乐句不要僵硬

expressif et souple.meaning: expressively and with supple, flexible phrasing
expressif et souple.zh: 富有表情地，乐句柔韧而灵活

espressif et souple.meaning: expressively and with supple, flexible phrasing
espressif et souple.zh: 富有表情地，乐句柔韧而灵活

solo.meaning: a featured line for one player
solo.zh: 独奏，突出一位演奏者的声部

pressez.meaning: press forward, gradually quickening the tempo
pressez.zh: 向前推进，逐渐加快速度

au mouv.meaning: return to the previous tempo; short for au mouvement
au mouv.zh: 恢复先前的速度（au mouvement 的缩写）
